definitions.explanation: The process of preparing food, including cutting, heating, and combining ingredients.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{調理|ちょうり}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{調理|ちょうり}⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。

notes:
FORMS:
{調|ちょう} (arrange/prepare) + {理|り} (manage/reason)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {調理|ちょうり}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to cook, to prepare
- {調理|ちょうり}{器具|きぐ} - cooking utensils
- {調理|ちょうり}⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧ - cooking method
- {調理|ちょうり}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ - cooking time
- {調理|ちょうり}⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧ - pre-cooked
- {調理|ちょうり}{師|し} - chef (licensed)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ - cooking, dish, cuisine (broader; includes the result)
- {調理|ちょうり} focuses on the process/technique; ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ can mean both the act and the finished dish

REGISTER:
Slightly formal/technical. Common in recipes, professional contexts, and product labels.
